question: Which deities are assigned to the Īśāna, eastern, and southern fire-pits?
premises: Lakṣmī is assigned to the eastern fire-pit
The Mothers are assigned to the southern fire-pit
The Īśāna fire-pit is also specified in the arrangement
inference: Lakṣmī is placed in the eastern fire-pit and the Mothers in the southern, with the Īśāna fire-pit included in the scheme
uncertainties: the exact deity for the Īśāna fire-pit is not explicitly named in this verse
plain_english: In the Īśāna fire-pit and in the eastern fire-pit Lakṣmī, and in the southern the Mothers are placed.
